raw:
The 2011 German Grand Prix was won by Lewis Hamilton (McLaren). It was round 10 of the 2011 season, held at the Nürburgring on 24 July 2011, and he started from 2nd on the grid. Fernando Alonso finished second and Mark Webber third.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
